evals.expected_output: Agent reads the current branch's PR (diff + surrounding code), pulls the linked Jira ticket if present, checks local hygiene and CI/review state, and returns a tight status brief leading with the answer.
expectations: Resolves the PR for the current branch
Reads the diff AND the surrounding/changed files, not just the hunks
Checks local branch hygiene (dirty tree, unpushed commits, stashes on branch)
Leads the brief with the answer rather than a line-by-line diff recital

evals.prompt: catch me up on this PR
evals.expected_output: The skill is invoke-only: a bare phrasing cue should NOT auto-trigger it.
expectations: The skill does not auto-activate on the phrasing cue alone
If it does not run, the agent does not fabricate a catch-up brief

evals.prompt: /pr-catchup (branch has no PR, and no gh CLI authenticated)
evals.expected_output: Agent notes the missing tool/source in one clause, asks the user to supply the PR number/URL rather than guessing, and does not fabricate a PR or ticket id.
expectations: States the gh CLI is unavailable rather than silently failing
Asks the user for a PR number/URL instead of guessing
Does not invent a PR number or a Jira id
Degrades gracefully with a one-clause note instead of blocking
